research.facts:
Presidents Cup — Teams Arrive, Practice Begins
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Presidents Cup 2026 dates: September 24-27 at Medinah Country Club (Course No. 3), Medinah, Illinois
- Practice rounds: Tuesday September 22 and Wednesday September 23
- Pairings for Thursday's fourballs typically announced Wednesday
- Format Day 1 (Thursday Sept. 24): Five fourball matches (tee times 11:35 AM CDT)
- Format Day 2 (Friday Sept. 25): Five foursomes matches
- Format Day 3 (Saturday Sept. 26): Five fourballs matches
- Format Day 4 (Sunday Sept. 27): Twelve singles matches
- Total points available: 30 (USA needs 15.5 to win)
- USA captain: Brandt Snedeker; International captain: Geoff Ogilvy
- USA automatic qualifiers: Scottie Scheffler, Cameron Young, Wyndham Clark, Sam Burns, Russell Henley, Collin Morikawa
- USA captain's picks: Chris Gotterup, Xander Schauffele, Justin Thomas, Jacob Bridgeman, Patrick Cantlay, Jackson Koivun
- USA all-time record: 13 wins, 2 losses (1 draw) — chasing 11th consecutive title
- TV: NBC/Golf Channel
**Sources:** PGA Tour, Wikipedia, Golf Monthly, Sky Sports, ESPN

research.facts:
Jackson Koivun Presidents Cup Debut
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Jackson Koivun is 21 years old; turned professional after leaving Auburn University
- Named to USA team as a captain's pick on September 1, 2026 by Brandt Snedeker
- Youngest USA player since Jordan Spieth in 2015 Presidents Cup
- Won the 2026 3M Open in just his third professional PGA Tour start
- 3M Open result: Won at 25-under 259, defeating world No. 1 Scottie Scheffler by 3 strokes; set 72-hole tournament scoring record
- Qualified for FedExCup Playoffs in just his fifth start on Tour
- Snedeker: "I just have a gut feeling" about Koivun's performance at Medinah
- Three players on USA team were not born the last time the Internationals won (1998)
**Sources:** Sky Sports, Yahoo Sports, PGA Tour, Golf Channel, Heavy.com, Wikipedia

research.facts:
LIV Golf Player Commitment Deadline
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- LIV Golf filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy on September 8, 2026
- 35-day player commitment deadline from filing = October 13, 2026 (21 days away from Sept. 22)
- Requirement: 50% of players by count + 2/3 of total dollar-value claims must commit
- BC Partners leading $300M restructuring; PIF providing $49.6M DIP financing and fully exiting
- Restructured entity would be majority player-owned
- Cameron Smith: "I have made my bed" — committed to staying with LIV
- Bryson DeChambeau: committed to LIV restructured future
- Jon Rahm: committed to staying
- Brooks Koepka: returned to PGA Tour before bankruptcy filing
- PGA Tour offered a "one-time defined window" for LIV players to apply for reinstatement; deadline passed February 2, 2026
- Rahm and DeChambeau rejected the PGA Tour reinstatement offer
- Jon Rahm owed $100M+ per court filings; DeChambeau also listed as creditor
**Sources:** Golf.com, Sportico, Golf Digest, CBS Sports, Flashscore, Golfmagic

stories.title: International Team's 28-Year Drought — Can Ogilvy's Side End It at Medinah?

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text: International team hasn't won the Presidents Cup since 1998. That's 28 years. 12 consecutive losses. USA leads 13-2 all-time. Ogilvy's team knows history is not on their side. But Medinah is where upsets happen. ⛳️ #PresidentsCup

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text: If the International team wins this week at Medinah, it would be one of the biggest upsets in team golf history. They have Matsuyama, Tom Kim, Adam Scott, Min Woo Lee, Ryan Fox. What do you think — can they do it? #PresidentsCup

research.facts:
International Team's 28-Year Drought
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- International team's last Presidents Cup victory: 1998 (Royal Melbourne)
- USA all-time Presidents Cup record: 13 wins, 2 losses (1 draw)
- International losses: 2000, 2003, 2005, 2007, 2009, 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2022, 2024
- Geoff Ogilvy is 2026 International team captain (Australian; 2006 US Open winner)
- International automatic qualifiers include: Hideki Matsuyama (Japan), Sungjae Im (South Korea), Adam Scott (Australia), Tom Kim (South Korea), Min Woo Lee (Australia)
- International captain's picks: Corey Conners (Canada), Harold Varner III... [Ogilvy picks include Conners, Taylor, Echavarria, Im, Hisatsune, Bezuidenhout]
- Medinah Country Club (Medinah, Illinois) — historically USA-friendly territory
- Medinah previously hosted 1991, 1999, 2012 Ryder Cups
**Sources:** Wikipedia, CBS Sports, Sky Sports, PGA Tour

Walmart NW Arkansas Championship
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Walmart NW Arkansas Championship 2026 dates: September 25-27 at Pinnacle Country Club, Rogers, Arkansas
- 20th year of the event at the venue
- Format: 54-hole stroke play, no cut
- Field: 144 players
- Purse: $3 million
- Nelly Korda is world No. 1 on LPGA; won 2026 Chevron Championship and 2026 US Women's Open
- 17 players in the field who participated in the 2026 Solheim Cup
- 2026 Solheim Cup: USA lost 13-15 to Europe (held in the Netherlands)
- Korda went unbeaten in Solheim singles; beat Mimi Rhodes 4 and 2 on Sunday
- First LPGA event featuring Solheim Cup participants since the team competition
**Sources:** NWA Homepage, Sky Sports, Wikipedia (2026 LPGA Tour), LPGA.com
